stories.title: Zelensky adviser: Ukrainians dying as US missile warnings lag
stories.summary: A senior adviser to President Zelensky told the BBC that Ukrainians have died because US warnings of incoming ballistic missiles remain incomplete and can arrive as little as a minute before impact. The White House says intelligence sharing is unchanged, while Kyiv also reports unresolved restrictions on Starlink and Starshield.

stories.title: Four Canadian troops killed as wildfire overruns Alberta base
stories.summary: Four Canadian service members died and 39 were injured when a grass fire swept a live-fire training area at CFB Wainwright in Alberta, with a commander saying wind drove the blaze a kilometre in 30 to 60 seconds. Officials ruled out terrorism; 19 of the injured are in critical condition.

stories.title: Kenyan court convicts starvation cult leader over 191 child deaths
stories.summary: A Kenyan court found doomsday preacher Paul Mackenzie and followers guilty in the starvation deaths of 191 children, whose bodies were found in shallow graves in Shakahola forest. Prosecutors said his doctrine barred education and modern medicine and told parents to let children die to 'meet Jesus'.

stories.title: Australian MP critically injured in apparent car attack
stories.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines, 65, is critically ill after being hit by a car outside her Wangaratta office in Victoria, an incident Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called a deliberate act. A 43-year-old man was detained at the scene, a knife was found in the vehicle and counter-terror police are assisting.

stories.title: Hackers breach OpenCode, run up charges on users' AI accounts
stories.summary: Open-source AI coding agent OpenCode said attackers broke into an older system overnight and affected 1.4% of users on OpenCode Console, where some store AI service API keys. Anthropic and Google blocked exposed keys, and OpenAI refunded credits spent during the intrusion.

stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5B at $6.2B valuation for open-weight AI chips
stories.summary: Inference chip startup Tenstorrent raised $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation, more than doubling its late-2024 mark, to scale silicon built for serving open-weight models. CEO Jim Keller said the company stayed independent after showing its Galaxy servers could run DeepSeek models.

stories.title: Apple teases MacBook Pro event for next week
stories.summary: Apple is teasing a product launch next week, with the headline expected to be a lighter MacBook Pro featuring an OLED touchscreen and an iPhone-style Dynamic Island. A 14-inch MacBook Pro and an iMac running the new M6 chip are also expected.

stories.title: Nvidia ships open models for enterprise and on-device agents
stories.summary: Nvidia released the 120-billion-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for enterprise agents plus two small Bolt models that run locally on RTX Spark AI PCs and DGX Spark workstations. Nvidia claims Super VL finishes agentic tasks faster than rival flagship models when post-trained on specific workflows.

stories.title: Browns defense grades: the unit that kept Cleveland in it
stories.summary: cleveland.com graded Cleveland's defense after the 13-10 comeback over Baltimore, breaking down Carson Schwesinger, Denzel Ward and the rest of a group that forced the late Derrick Henry fumble setting up the tying score. The Ravens went scoreless on their final nine possessions.

stories.title: Browns offense grades: a late drive rescues a rough afternoon
stories.summary: cleveland.com's position-by-position grades cover an offense that had 107 yards through three quarters before Deshaun Watson's 10-play, 62-yard march set up the winning field goal. Watson finished 16-of-26 for 164 yards, with Jerry Jeudy's 33-yard catch the key play.

stories.title: OBR daily: Browns 4-2 after another fourth-quarter escape
stories.summary: The Orange and Brown Report's Monday column revisited a first half in which Watson went 3-of-9 for 24 yards and Cleveland trailed 10-0, before Todd Monken's team produced a fourth win decided in the closing moments. The Browns are 4-2 and tied with Baltimore and Pittsburgh atop the AFC North.
stories.source: The Orange and Brown Report via cleveland19

stories.title: From practice squad to hero: Audric Estimé's first week with Browns
stories.summary: Cleveland's official site detailed how Estimé signed off Minnesota's practice squad on Oct. 13 and scored the game-tying 2-yard touchdown against Baltimore five days later. He arrived with the backfield depleted by injuries to Quinshon Judkins, Dylan Sampson and Raheim Sanders.

stories.title: Ohio State-USC set for 7:30 p.m. on NBC4 on Halloween
stories.summary: The Oct. 31 Big Ten game between No. 3 Ohio State and No. 16 USC will kick off at 7:30 p.m. ET at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum on NBC4. Ohio State is on a bye this week while the 6-1 Trojans host Wisconsin.

stories.title: How Ohio State survived Indiana without its starting QB
stories.summary: Land-Grant Holy Land's breakdown credited the defense with holding Indiana to 73 rushing yards and forcing two fumbles in the 19-15 win, while noting Julian Sayin struggled before a fourth-quarter injury expected to cost him several weeks. True freshman Luke Fahey now takes over with a bye week to prepare.

stories.title: Big Ten recap: Buckeyes snap Indiana's 22-game streak, lose Sayin
stories.summary: The Big Ten's weekly review of Ohio State's 19-15 win at Indiana focused on Jeremiah Smith's 38-yard fourth-down touchdown, his 39th career scoring catch, tying Braylon Edwards' conference record. Sayin exited with an upper-body injury Ryan Day said will keep him out several weeks, and Nick Marsh's last-minute catch landed out of bounds to end Indiana's threat.

stories.title: Indiana's Hoover takes blame for the throw that decided it
stories.summary: Indiana quarterback Josh Hoover said his ball placement, not Nick Marsh's footwork, cost the Hoosiers a game-winning touchdown on fourth down against Ohio State. Coach Curt Cignetti was blunt about the play: 'We had it and we just didn't make it.'

stories.title: Bottas raises nearly €50,000 for rhino charity with helmet auction
stories.summary: Valtteri Bottas has raised almost €50,000 for rhino conservation through an F1 helmet fundraiser, with the sport heading into the United States Grand Prix weekend in Austin. The total turns a race-weekend collectible into a five-figure donation.

stories.title: Pérez calls debut Cadillac season 'one of my best years'
stories.summary: In an interview with Motorsport.com, Sergio Pérez rejected the idea that 2026 is his worst season, pointing to his driving level and leadership role in shaping Cadillac's first car despite the team sitting last in the constructors' standings. He said people inside the sport know the level he is operating at.

stories.title: McLaren's last 2026 upgrades double as 2027 concept tests
stories.summary: McLaren will roll out its final 2026 updates across Austin, Mexico City and São Paulo, deliberately spreading them over three different track types. Team principal Andrea Stella said the parts also test 'fundamental concepts' that will carry into next year's car while McLaren fights for constructors' points now.

stories.title: Hamilton and Verstappen want Marina Bay layout changed
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen both say Singapore's Marina Bay circuit needs a longer straight or a proper hairpin to create better racing. Hamilton, who loves the venue, said the pair had discussed layout tweaks after a street-circuit weekend that drew criticism over overtaking.

stories.title: Tarkov players report fresh wave of desync and connection problems
stories.summary: A r/EscapefromTarkov thread declaring desync 'hasn't been this bad in years' drew quick agreement, with a parallel thread reporting lag and connection drops across raids. The complaints land with the game on patch 1.2.0.0, which added PvE Prestige levels and reworked PMC bot behaviour on Oct. 6.

stories.title: Columbus festivals shift from haunted houses to holidays
stories.summary: NBC4's roundup marks the handoff from Halloween to the winter season: Boo at the Zoo and the Ohio Renaissance Festival close out Oct. 25, while an all-new Christkindlmarkt, Wildlights and Fashion Week Columbus fill November. Haunted Fest takes over KEMBA Live on Oct. 30.

stories.title: Cooper Stadium owner answers city code and zoning citations
stories.summary: Columbus has issued several notices to the owner of the long-vacant Cooper Stadium site over overgrown weeds, graffiti, unsecured buildings, unapproved dumpsters and shipping containers stacked two-high around the surviving grandstand. The developer has now responded to the violations.

stories.title: Judge keeps bonds in place for parents in Licking County child case
stories.summary: A judge upheld bonds for the parents arrested after nine children were removed from a Licking County home, a case that began with a school district tip to child protective services. Deputies had reported possible abuse and substandard living conditions at the property.

stories.title: Columbus lands first nonstop Europe flight, to Frankfurt in 2027
stories.summary: Columbus will get its first nonstop route to Europe in May 2027, with Frankfurt flights leaving at 4:20 p.m. and landing at 6:15 a.m. local time. Tickets go on sale Tuesday, Oct. 20; Mayor Andrew Ginther said the deal was years in the making.
